The '''Swellbottom market''' was a merchants' area on the [[planet]] [[Balmorra]]. During the [[Imperial Era]], the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] found a store there that sold animals in exchange for [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].<ref name="Smuggler's Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Swellbottom market was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Smuggler's Guide]]'', a reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and released in [[2018]].<ref name="Smuggler's Guide" />
